# Generated Configuration Field Reference

<!-- Generated by src/tools/generate_config_field_reference.py; do not edit manually. -->

Field declarations live in `src/config/field_registry.py`; descriptor types live in `src/config/field_spec.py`. Defaults remain owned by `src/config/schema.py` and Rust strategy metadata. Run `PYTHONPATH=src python src/tools/generate_config_field_reference.py --check` to check this file.

Types declare canonical serialization. Numeric export changes spelling only when it preserves the value; it never rounds fractional values into integer fields. Nullability is separate from numeric type. Existing field validators continue to own accepted inputs and semantic constraints. A descriptor grants no override or optimization permission.

`*` denotes one record index or dynamic map key. Coin patches and literal override paths reuse the addressed field's type. Numeric optimizer bounds reuse their target bot field's type through the existing optimizer path adapter. Optional fields with no declared default are documented without supplying runtime authority. This reference lists both supported strategy kinds; runtime loading retains only the active kind.

Scope, consumers, domains, override permissions, display order, units/denominators, and recommended bounds are available as descriptor metadata. Unspecified metadata is unknown, not a permission or domain assertion; later consumers must not interpret it as authority. Rust strategy recommendations and fixed-parameter choices come from Rust metadata.
